attempt_preimage_sha256.description: RFC3161 message-imprint preimage SHA-256 carried by this exact request. For a successful record it equals the record proof preimage; for a missed Issue caused by TSA failure it equals failed_candidate_on_time_core.candidate_core_sha256.

preimage_profile.description: The normal profile omits exactly timestamp_attempt_evidence, remote_timestamp, and content_sha256. The missed-audit profile omits exactly missed_audit_timestamp_attempt_evidence, missed_audit_remote_timestamp, and content_sha256. Omissions are top-level only.

source_snapshot_sha256.description: SHA-256 of seismoflux_canonical_json_v1 object with exactly profile, source_id, canonical_query_request_sha256, response_headers_sha256, raw_response_sha256, response_content_type, response_body_byte_count, http_status, fetch_started_at_utc, and fetch_completed_at_utc.
